title: Selman Mujovic (CEO, Purafide) — reading Incorruptible on the NYC subway at 1am during Climate Week
summary: Selman Mujovic — CEO of Purafide (Brooklyn-based water and sustainability tech) — posts a moment from Climate Week: late night at the lab, could have called a taxi home, chose the subway with Incorruptible in hand. 36 likes on the vignette that quietly makes the point about walking the walk.
blockquote: The Empire State is lit blue for water as NYC starts Climate Week. A late night at the lab, surprisingly common, calls for a taxi home. Always putting my money (time) where my mouth is, I take the subway home with Eric Ries's Incorruptible in hand. As I try to quantify the true value of sustainability, this packed train at 1am reflects it without realizing it. Another lesson learned in the World's Borough.
